Commentary.Commentary: This was the perfect start Pakistan could have asked for after their defeat in the Test series. It was a clinical performance from them and they will be pleased with it. South Africa may have lost, but there certainly are positives to take for them from this game, along with the lessons. The next game takes place on Tuesday, in Durban, at 1300 local (1100 GMT). Do join in for that. Cheers!

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed, says the credit goes to the bowlers first. Also applauds Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam for the way they played. Reckons that they won the game in the middle when the spinners kept it tight and never let the opposition get away with the game. On his captaincy, he says he's always been an animated character and that's how he'll always be.

Man of the Match, Mohammad Hafeez, says it was a great team effort as they first restricted South Africa to a decent score and then chased it down. Mentions that if you win the first game of the series, it always provides good momentum. States that they were always confident after restricting South Africa to 266 and after the start the openers gave, the task became much easier.

South Africa skipper, Faf du Plessis, says they were 10-15 runs short and rues the fact that they couldn't capitalize on the foundation laid by Hashim Amla and Rassie van der Dussen. Credits Pakistan for pacing the chase well and admits there are lessons to take from this game. On Hashim Amla, he says he's found some form since the Test series and also applauds Rassie van der Dussen for the way he played. Adds that these are positive signs, especially with the upcoming World Cup in mind. Continues saying that they needed to adapt to the conditions better, like Pakistan did, particularly in the middle overs, and that is something they should learn from.

South Africa, after posting a below par total on the board, couldn't get the early wickets they needed. And couldn't stem the flow of runs in the middle overs either. The Pakistan top order put its side in a comfortable position, which in turn helped the experience in the middle order to take the visitors home. A few wickets did fall in quick succession towards the end, but the game was more or less over by then. Earlier in the day, South Africa made their way to 266 on the back of a Amla hundred and a van der Dussen 93, but despite that, they couldn't post a score which would be enough.

Despite it going to the last over, it was a commanding win for the Men in Green. The task wasn't that difficult to begin with, but the Pakistan top order made that job that much easier. The openers added 45, and after Zaman's departure, Imam (who missed out on a ton) carried the torch forward. He made two superb partnerships with Azam and Hafeez worth 94 and 46 respectively, which more or less sealed the deal. Hafeez then came in, used his experience, shouldered the responsibility well and saw his side home, remaining unbeaten on 71.

And there's the game! PAKISTAN WIN BY 5 WICKETS! Comfortably done too in the end. Shadab Khan digs this yorker out towards mid on and sets off. Takes the fielder on and wins that contest. Smiles and handshakes all around in the Pakistan camp, deservedly so too.
FOUR! The scores are level now. Hafeez makes Olivier pay for bowling short so consistently. Just stands tall and pulls this aerially through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pounds it in short again, the batsman looks to pull but misses and is hit around the shoulder. It lobs behind to the keeper who dives to his right and stops it.
Another short ball from Olivier, Hafeez pulls it through mid-wicket for two more.
In the air and safe! Seems to going Pakistan's way. Back of a length and Hafeez pulls. Gets a big fat top edge which lobs over the keeper's head towards fine leg. The batsmen take two.
Outside the line of off stump, on a good length, dabbed wide of point for one.
FOUR! Looks like Pakistan are winning this. This is a super hit. Length ball on middle and leg, Shadab makes room and bangs this over the bowler's head. Hits it too straight and finds the fence.
Shortish delivery, pulled away behind square leg. Fine leg moves across to his left and keeps the batsmen to just the one.
Yorker fired in on middle and leg, Shadab does well to bring his bat down in time.
The batsman plays this very late. Runs it down to third man and takes a couple of runs.
Another bumper, ducked and evaded by the batsman. The umpire signals one for the over.
Bangs in the short one, Shadab arches back to play the ramp shot but fails to make connection.
Behind a good length in the off stump corridor, it's worked to third man. Single to the total.
Full and attacking the stumps, worked towards wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! What a shot. Too good a player to miss out on this. A full toss from Olivier, Hafeez with the full face of the bat lofts it over mid off and finds the fence.
Works it away on the leg side. No run taken.
FOUR! Premeditated that and got the result. Full and down leg, Hafeez gets forward and across, a little low too and sweeps it fine down the leg side, beating the diving keeper to the fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Width offered outside off as Olivier pitches it on a length, guided to third man for one run.
Duanne Olivier back into the attack.
Eases this away through to long on and keeps strike. 28 runs needed off 24 balls.
Full in length around off, driven to the cover fielder.
Too far outside off, placed behind point off the back foot. Big gap out there, so two runs are taken.
Back of a length into the body, worked behind square on the leg side for one.
Full delivery in line of the stumps, driven to mid on for nothing.
Room on offer outside off, Shadab opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Kagiso Rabada is back into the attack.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through quickly for a single.
Short and outside off, punched from the back foot through to sweeper cover for a brace.
Tossed up leg break on middle, played off the outer half towards cover. Shadab wanted the run, but goes back in time.
Another single. Hafeez eases it to long off and crosses over.
Fuller outside off, squeezed to third man for one more.
Full ball sliding in on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Down to third man for a single and with that, Mohammad Hafeez brings up his fifty, his 35th in ODI cricket. Cuts this late and gets to the other end. Needless to say, if Pakistan are to win, he has to be there till the end.
Short of a good length close to off, Hafeez blocks it by going on the back foot.
On a good length and outside off, Hafeez looks to cut this late down to third man but fails to make connection.
Fraction straight in line, tucked through square leg for a couple of runs.
Full and straight from Phehlukwayo, Hafeez plays it back in the direction of the bowler.
Length ball cutting back in on middle and leg, it's worked to the man in front of square leg.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Dot ball to end the over.
Goes with the spin as he dabs this with an open face to point for a single.
Quicker through the air, on middle stump, kept out from inside the crease.
Looped up leg break outside off, Shadab gets low to sweep but it goes off the pad through the keeper's right. A leg bye is taken.
Shadab Khan to bat now.

OUT! Another Pakistan wicket down in quick succession. Brilliant from Imran Tahir. He bowls it on leg and it's the leg break. Spins ever so much and beats the closed face of the bat as Sarfraz tries to flick. He's caught on the back pad and an appeal goes up, which is followed by the finger. The DRS is signalled by Ahmed and replays don't help him at all. He's gone for all money. Pakistan lose their review as well.
Review time. Huge moment. Skipper Sarfraz has been caught leg before and been given out. He's taken the DRS quickly. This looks close. Let's see what happens.
Full and straight, driven straight back to the bowler.
FOUR! Superb. Poor ball, good shot. Too full and quite straight in line, Hafeez close the face and flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Full ball on off, the batsman prods forward and meets it with his defensive bat.
Back of a length on off, blocked out from the back foot.
The Pakistan skipper is off the mark immediately. Length delivery around off, Sarfraz opens the bat face and guides it to third man for a single.
Sarfraz Ahmed walks out to the middle next.

OUT! Maybe, just maybe, there is something left in this game. Everyone knows what a big player Shoaib Malik is in such situations, his calm and experience usually see Pakistan home. But this... this could just provide the hosts some hope needed to push on from here. Length delivery on off, Malik looks to run it down to third man but gets an inside edge and the ball disturbs the furniture behind. 49 needed off 52.
Length ball on middle and it skids off the deck, Malik looks to work it across the line but is caught on the thigh pad.
Andile Phehlukwayo is called back on.
Hafeez defends this one by getting right behind the line.
Quicker and flatter on the stumps, Hafeez meets it with a straight blade in response.
Stays on the back foot and punches it to the covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. One run added to the total.
SIX! BAM! That's a cool hit. So calmly done by The Professor. Tossed up around off, Hafeez gets close to the pitch by stepping out and smokes it over long on for half a dozen.
Shorter ball around off, punched wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the match. Also, Imran Tahir to have a change of ends.
Shortish delivery just outside off, Shoaib backs away and steers it to the fielder at third man for a run. Pakistan need 58 runs to win in 60 balls.
Arrows it full and fast on middle and leg, it's wristed in front of square leg for no run.
Pushes this full delivery to mid off. Can't get it past the fielder.
Hafeez premeditates the scoop shot, but Pretorius bowls it full and just outside off. the batsman, however, adjusts late and places it behind point for a single. Nicely done.
Fullish in length once more, on off, blocked by taking a big stride forward.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Hafeez defends it down on the leg side.
Dwaine Pretorius returns to the attack.
Bumper outside off, Malik lets it be. Looks to the umpire for the wide but doesn't get it. Maybe a bit harsh on the official's end.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Too far outside off, it goes from the other side of the tramline, wide signalled.
SIX! BANG! That's outta here! The Professor teaching everyone how it's done! Fuller length ball around off, Hafeez slogs it over wide long on and gets a maximum to his name.
Cutting back in from a good length, nudged through square leg to rotate strike.
Yorker speared in on the stumps, dug out towards mid off by the batter.
Length ball on the fourth stump line, Malik looks to cut but mistimes the chop on the off side.
Length delivery just around off, hit through to long off and a single is collected.
The Professor makes use of his feet, gets closer to the pitch and drives it through the covers for a run.
Floated up outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Quicker through the air on middle and off, Malik defends it by staying inside his crease.
Looped up leg break outside off, Hafeez goes with the spin and drives it through covers for one run.
Full ball fired in on off, driven down the ground to long off for a run.
Shorter in length once again, defended down on the leg side for a brisk run. 74 needed in 78 balls.

FOUR! Poor line and Olivier pays the price. Short ball down the leg side, all Malik has to do is help it on its way and it's all too easy from there. It races across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Another short ball, pulled away into the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Hafeez looks to play at it but misses.
Too straight in line, nudged fine down the leg side for two.
Shoaib Malik to bat next.

OUT! Olivier with the big break. This is a massive breakthrough and could be the turning point in the game. Imam with a rather rash shot at a crucial juncture. Fuller length ball around off, the opener charges out and looks to go big, but it goes off the outer half and flies over covers. Hendricks in the deep runs in and dives forward to take an excellent catch. Imam misses out on what would have been a well-deserved ton.
Change of ends for Olivier.
FOUR! No, he can't. Short and wide, Hafeez plays and gets a thick edge. It runs down to third man for a boundary.
One ball left in this over. Can Tahir provide the breakthrough?

Dropped! That was the moment South Africa needed. A bit difficult, but you'd expect him to take it. Looped up delivery on off, Imam punches it back on the up. Tahir goes to his left and sticks his hands out, but can't keep a hold of it.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back. Dot ball.
Quicker, flatter and spinning in on off, the southpaw goes back and punches it to mid on.
Quicker and fuller well outside off, a mistimed drive finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up leg break outside off, turning in, Imam is well forward in defense.
Imran Tahir comes back on to bowl.
Ahead of a good length, close to the off stump again, the batsman defends rather comfortably.
Full in length, aiming the off pole, Hafeez brings a straight blade down in response.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

SIX! What a massive hit! The sound off the bat was just sumptuous. He's just crunched that. Full and right in the slot, Imam steps out and just gives it the full swing of the bat and launches it deep into the stands over the cow corner.
Pats this away with soft hands on the off side and the pair steals a quick single.
Length ball on off, defended with the full face of the bat.

Hafeez moves inside the line and helps the pull behind square leg. One good run is there to be had. The number is below the three-figure mark now. Pakistan require 95 runs to win. Cruising along here.
Hurled wide outside off, full in length, left alone.
FOUR! Sweet. That's all there is to it. Overpitched delivery from Olivier, on off, Hafeez strides forward and drives it well through the gap in the covers to find the fence.

Tap and run stuff from Imam-ul-Haq. Good running between the wickets. He plays it down in front of cover-point and both batsmen scamper across. Faf du Plessis from cover moves to his right, gets to the ball and misses his shy at the striker's end.
Full again, outside off, driven firmly but to the mid off fielder.
Imam uses the angle away from him. Slightly opens the face of the bat and drives it to backward point.
Duanne Olivier is brought back into the attack.
Close. Hafeez works this to short fine leg and takes off. The throw comes in to the keeper but Imam is quick to get to the other end.
FOUR! All timing, that. Well struck by Hafeez. Full and outside off, he just leans into the drive and caresses it past the diving extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller and outside off, a hint of inward shape, Hafeez plays away from his body and gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Seams back in, touch fullish in length, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, Imam reaches out, opens the bat face and steers it to third man for a single.
A half-appeal for a caught behind, the umpire doesn't bother. Quick and full darted outside off, Hafeez looks to cut this away but misses. Klaasen collects and appeal, to no avail though.
Quicker one on the stumps, it goes off the inside half on the leg side and the batsmen cross over.
Has to reach out a bit. Quite slow through the air outside off, Hafeez drives it through point for a run.
Goes with the spin and turns it away to the man at square leg.
Turning away from around off, shorter in length, Imam goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
Looped up delivery on middle stump, swept through to deep mid-wicket for a single.

That's in the air but in the gap as well. Pretorius takes the pace off it and as a result, Hafeez is early into the flick shot. Ends up chipping it through the gap in the mid-wicket region. One run taken to end the over. 110 runs needed for Pakistan to win in 19 overs.
Targets the off stick with this length delivery and the batsman dabs it to point with an open face.
FOUR! Gives the charge and takes the attack to Pretorius. Jumps out to this back of a length ball around off and drags the heave through the right of mid on for a boundary.
Stays behind to this length ball and keeps it out safely.
Angles this length ball across, outside off, punched off the back foot through the covers for a single.
Good length ball on middle stump, it's clipped away through square leg for a double.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Drives this full ball to long on and takes a single.

Safe! The Professor lives to fight another day! Straighter one outside off, Hafeez comes ahead to defend but it goes past the outside edge. Klaasen takes the bails off and appeals, as the batsman drags his back leg out. It goes upstairs and replays show that he managed to get his leg back just in time.
Stumping appeal is referred upstairs. Mohammad Hafeez is the man in question. Not much buzz about this one though.
Gives the charge to this floated ball and pushes it to the right of the bowler for a run.
Slower through the air, on off stump and it turns away, Imam plants his front foot forward and defends.
FOUR! Some width on offer and Imam pounces on it instantly. Short and outside off, the left-hander rocks onto the back foot in a jiffy and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Good length delivery on middle and off, cramping the batsman for room, Hafeez stays inside the crease and defends.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Fullish in length outside off, driven to the covers. Dot ball.
Going away from the batsman again, Imam tries to put bat on ball but misses.
Back of a length angling across, Imam walks down the track and slices the cut square on the off side for a double.
Ahead of a length, in line of the stumps, driven back down the track for no run.
Mohammad Hafeez is the new man in. Also, Dwaine Pretorius is back on to bowl.

OUT! Oh, would you look at that? Well done, Faf. What a change. Reeza Hendricks provides the much-needed breakthrough South Africa have been craving for. And it's the big one of Babar Azam. Landed outside off on a shorter length and it spins in, Babar goes back to force the punch through the covers but misses the ball altogether. It goes past the outside edge and clatters into the stumps. Partnership of 94 is brought to a close.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
The batsman gives the charge and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Landed on a driving length, on middle and off, blocked off the front foot.
Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slightly ahead of a length, close to off, Azam is half-forward in defense.
Reeza Hendricks to have a go with the ball. Faf du Plessis is looking for some inspiration, maybe this will be the one that makes the difference.
Full delivery outside off, driven straight to the fielder positioned at mid off.
Angling back in on middle and leg, Azam moves inside the line and helps the pull down to fine leg for one.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Babar looks to run it down to third man but gets a feather to the keeper behind on the bounce.
Flicked away with the wrists but straight to the fielder. Babar Azam works it away but to the man in front of square leg.
Outside off on a good length, shaping away, it's run down to third man for one more.
Fraction straight in line, worked away into the leg side for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, spinning in, Imam pushes it through mid off for one run.
Over the wicket to Babar. It's tossed up around off, the batsman eases it through covers and changes ends.
Around the wicket to Imam, it's fuller and drifting in around off, it goes off the inside edge as the batsman goes for the drive away from his body. It rolls to square leg and a run is collected.
Through the gap in the covers this time. A comfortable single picked up.
Quicker through the air around off, the right-hander is well forward as he pushes it towards covers.
Back of a length ball which just sits up for Babar. He rides the bounce and pulls it in front of square leg for a single. Pakistan need 138 runs to win in 25 overs.
Banged in short, pulled behind square leg for an easy single.
Waits for the ball to come to him before opening the face and running it down to third man. Single taken.
Short ball angling into the body, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Babar stays back and pats it away on the off side.
Angling in from around the wicket, on a length, Imam flicks it through square leg and takes a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full and straight from the bowler, hit back down the track.
Leans into this full ball and pushes it towards mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it right up there, driven towards mid on for one.
Slightly shorter in length, kept out off the back foot.
Bouncer! Imam pulls it brilliantly to towards mid-wicket. Andile Phehlukwayo comes from square leg puts a dive and saves a certain boundary. The batsmen come back for the second.
Full on off, driven straight to the fielder at mid off.
Yorker outside off, Imam gets a bat to it and pushes it to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, flicked away on the leg side straight to the fielder.
Full on middle, Imam pushes it straight to mid on.
Around off, Azam keeps it out.
Kagiso Rabada is back for another spell.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. They pick up a single.
Once again shorter in length, Imam cuts it square towards point for a run.
Shorter in length this time, Azam cuts it on the off side for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, pushed to long on for  a run.
Full on middle, driven straight to long off for a run.

Once again he tosses it way up and Imam pushes it to long off for a single. Brings up the 50 for Imam. His 4th in ODI cricket. A wonderful innings here, needs to convert it to a big one and guide his side home now.
FOUR! Classy stuff from Babar. 5 singles and now a boundary to end the over. Outside off, Azam waits for it and cuts it wide of the third man fielder for a boundary.
Wide.  Azam watches the bouncer go way above his head.
5 in 5. Imam plays this towards mid off and gets to the other end.
Around off, hit through square leg for a run.
On top of off, played to the short third man fielder for another run. All too easy for the tourists now.
Back of a length ball on middle, Babar taps it to the on side and quickly responds to his partner's call. Very good running.
Outside off, guided towards short third man for a quick run.
Quicker on the pads, Azam flicks it to the fielder at square leg.
Tossed up outside off, Azam drives it straight to cover.
Low full toss again on the pads, Imam flicks it away for a single. He needs to pull back his length if he wants the ball to spin.

In the air but safe. Flighted delivery on middle, Babar pushes it uppishly wide of the bowler. Tahir tries to catch it by diving to his left but cannot get to it. The ball goes towards long off for a run.
Tossed up on off, pushed to the fielder at mid off.
Loopy full toss on off, Azam hits it straight back at the bowler.
On the leg side, Azam flicks it away to the on side for another run.
FOUR! Beautifully done! Outside off, just a fine delicate touch past the keeper and that is enough to tickle it away to the third man boundary.
Imam plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total. The 50-run stand comes between these two.
On the pads, flicked away by Imam. Duanne at the fine leg boundary dives and saves two for his team.
Full again on off, driven towards mid off. Another 'yes-no' situation but they deny the single.
Nice but just for one. On a good length on off, Babar drives it past covers for an easy single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Babar pushes it to long on for one run. He will keep the strike for the start of the next over.
Tossed up on off, Imam pushes it towards point for a run.
Flighted on off, Babar pushes it to cover for a single.
Drifting on the pads, flicked it on the leg side straight to the fielder.
Tossed up on middle and off, Azam hits it back at Tahir. He misfields it and Babar looks for a single. Imam sends him back.
Starts with a loopy leg spinner on middle and leg, Azam hits it straight back at the bowler.
First sign of spin. Imran Tahir into the attack for the first time today.
DRINKS! Pakistan are going well so far with the loss of just one wicket. The hosts will look to tighten things up now with spin.
Shorter on length, Azam pulls it away for a single and he will keep the strike at the start of the next over.
Length delivery outside off, Imam guides it to the fielder at third man and rotates the strike.
On the hips this time, Babar flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Good length outside off, pushed towards point for a single.
Beautiful shot but for just a run. Full on middle, Azam drives it wonderfully to long off for only a single.
Full on off, Imam runs it down to point for a single.
Slower ball on top of off, Babar taps it towards backward point and thinks of a run but denies it at the last moment.
Angles this into Azam who turns it to short mid-wicket. Dot ball.
On the legs for Imam who tucks it around the corner to rotate strike.
Outside off, Babar stands tall and punches it through covers for a single.
On off, tapped towards point. A loud 'NO' from Babar.
Fuller length on that fourth stump line, Imam drives it through covers for one.
Nicely played down the ground for a run. Outside off, punched to long off to retain strike.
BA flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, Azam plays it to mid-wicket and thinks of a run. Is rightly sent back by his partner.
FOUR! Welcome runs! Outside off, Babar goes for the drive but gets a fat edge which goes away from the keeper and into the third man fence.
Outside off, Imam runs it down to third man for one.
Fuller ball and on middle and leg, Imam with a straight bat hits it back to the bowler.
Wide! Way down leg, Imam tries flicking it but misses.
Full on middle and leg, Babar pushes it to the fielder at mid on.

FOUR! Exquisite! Full on middle, Babar Azam  beautifully times the straight drive and the ball goes to the fence. Pretorius tries to get his hand to it but the ball went past him like a tracer bullet.
Bottom edge. Length delivery outside off, Azam tries to guide it to third man but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces and reaches Klaasen on the bounce.
Shorter on length, Azam tries to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball falls short of the fielder at point. Lucky escape for Azam.
Length delivery on the pads, Imam flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length around off, Imam charges down the track and hits it straight to the fielder at mid off.
On a length, Azam defends it off the back foot to finish off the over.
Shorter in length outside off, Azam cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Full outside off, Imam pushes it to point and rotates the strike.
Shorter in length, Azam punches  it off the back foot on the off side for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Azam blocks it off his back foot.
He starts with a good length delivery outside off, Babar tries to cut but gets an inside edge.
Andile Phehlukwayo to have a go with the ball.
Leans into this full ball on off and drives it to mid off.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed down to third man for one.
Imam uses the angle into him as he works this to backward square leg and gets to the other end.
Back of a length ball outside off, some room on offer, Azam cuts it square on the off side for a run.
Imam flicks this away behind square leg and gets to the other end.
Touch straight in line, worked off the pads on the leg side.

FOUR! Third off the over. Once again he bowls it short and this time Babar nicely pulls it away through mid-wicket for a boundary. 14 runs off that over a brilliant one this for Pakistan. Contrasting to the previous one bowled by Olivier.
Full around off, Azam drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
WIDE! Needs to bowl that one again. Bouncer and it is too high. Azam doesn't even duck underneath it and the ball goes over his head to the keeper. The umpire signals it as wide.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Imam flicks it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Bouncer and Imam, unlike Fakhar Zaman is in control of the pull and hits it through mid-wicket for a superb boundary. Second of the over. Olivier is under pressure now.
FOUR! Wonderful shot. Overpitched by Olivier and Imam gets on his front foot and drives it between cover and point through the gap for a boundary.
Full on middle, Imam defends it off the front foot.
Powerplay 2 signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders can be kept outside the ring till the 40th over.
Full ball on the stumps, driven firmly but to the man positioned at mid on.
Just behind a good length, outside off, Babar opens the face of the bat and taps it down with gentle hands.
Angling away from a good length, around off, Imam waits for it, opens the bat face late and runs it down to third man for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Just ahead of a length, around off, it's defended well by coming half-forward.
Full ball fired across, Imam drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Full around off, Babar hits it straight to the fielder at point. Great over for South Africa, just a run and the big wicket off Fakhar Zaman.
Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Once again full on middle and off, Babar defends it off his front foot.
Full on off, Azam pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Babar Azam walks in at no.3.

OUT! The short ball has done the trick and Fakhar Zaman is heading for early showers. Duanne Olivier bowls it short, Fakhar never looked in control playing the pull shot today. He top edges this one as well but this time the top edge goes to the right of Dwaine Pretorius at fine leg, who takes a fine catch. The debutant gets his first wicket in ODI cricket. He carries his good form from Tests here..
Length delivery outside off, Imam guides it to third man for a run.
Change of ends for Duanne Olivier.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, Imam drives it straight back at Pretorius.
On a length once again and this time Fakhar hits it to mid off and takes a quick single.
Length delivery around off, Zaman pushes it to cover and looks for a single, but Imam sends him back.
Outside off on a length, Fakhar tries to punch that one but misses.
Starts with a length ball on middle and leg, Imam flicks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Dwaine Pretorius comes into the bowling attack.
Shorter in length on the pads, flicked away on the leg side for a run.
On a length around off, Fakhar hits it to mid off and takes a quick single.
Good length on middle and leg, flicked straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
SIX! Bouncer by Rabada. Fakhar Zaman tries to pull it but gets a top edge. It has enough on it to go over the fence at fine leg for a maximum.
On a length, Imam hits it to the fielder at cover.
Full on off, Fakhar hits it to mid on.
Duanne continues to bang it short. Bowls this outside off, Imam goes for the hook but cannot get bat to ball.
Length outside off, Imam cannot get it past backward point.
Short again, Zaman pulls it to the on side to rotate strike.
Short ball outside off, Imam gets behind it and pulls it towards mid on for one.
Defended off the back foot by Imam.
On a fuller length around off, Imam taps this in front of him.
On a good length on middle and leg, Zaman turns his bat to the leg side for nothing.
FOUR! Flashed away! Outside off again, there to be hit, Fakhar cuts it behind point for a boundary. Four from the moment it left the bat.
Comes round the wicket and darts in a perfect yorker in line of the stumps. Zaman does well to get bat to ball.
Missed out. Short and wide outside off. Fakhar cuts it but finds the man at backward point.
Good running. Plays this with soft hands to the on side and changes ends.
On a good length on the hips of Zaman who tucks it away for one.
Length ball outside off, Imam shoulders arms to it.
FOUR! Imam getting a move on now. Bouncer again by Olivier and this time Imam rocks onto his back foot and pulls it away on the leg side for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Imam with a good shot. Length delivery on middle and leg, Imam flicks it on the leg side through deep mid-wicket. The fielder from square leg gives it a chase and dives to stop the boundary but cannot stop it from going to the fence.
Length ball on middle and leg, flicked away for a single on the leg side.

NOT OUT! Zaman stays. The replays and Snicko confirm that there was no glove involved and it was just off the helmet. Bouncer from Olivier. Fakhar tried to pull it away but the ball raised quickly onto him. It hit his helmet and the ball was caught at point by Reeza Hendricks. The bowler and the fielders appealed but umpire turned it down. They had a discussion and decided to go for the review. The replays showed there was no bat or glove involved. South Africa lose their review and the debutant still awaits his maiden ODI wicket.
Is Zaman gone? He's been caught at point, but remains to be seen whether it's gone purely off the helmet or is there some involvement of the bat. South Africa have reviewed it.
SIX! Imam is off the mark and in some style. He comes down the track and hits the length ball on off, straight over Rabada's head for a maximum.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter in length, the ball hits Fakhar high on the thigh pads.
Full and driven straight back to the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Pulls back the length this time, Zaman flicks it towards mid-wicket and the fielder puts in a dive but cannot stop it from going to the fence.

FOUR! First boundary of the innings and it is from Fakhar Zaman. It is full on off, Zaman drives it straight back at the bowler. Rabada has no chance to save that one and the ball goes straight to the fence.
Length delivery on middle and leg, flicked straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Just one run off the debutant's over.
Shorter in length, Imam tries to break the shackles and goes for the pull but misses.
Full length on off, Imam is taking his time and defends this one as well.
Full and on off, Imam blocks it off the front foot.
Full outside off, Imam hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Starts his ODI career with a full length outside off, Zaman pushes it to cover and takes a quick single. First run on board for Pakistan.
Debutant, Duanne Olivier to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Fuller on off, pushed to mid off. Maiden over to start the innings.
Length delivery around off, ul-Haq pushes it to point.
Tempting Imam to drive by bowling outside off. He shoulders arms to it.
Shorter in length on off, Imam blocks it off his front foot.
Good length delivery on off, Imam defends it off his back foot and shouts a loud 'NO' to his partner.
Starts with a length delivery outside off. Imam leaves it alone.
We are back. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq to open the innings for Pakistan in this chase. Kagiso Rabada to start with the new ball.
